resource_load.note: CPU-bound markdown parsing and HTML sanitization. No DB or external calls.

performance_issues.description: No timeout on markdown rendering - large or malicious input could consume CPU indefinitely
performance_issues.impact: A single request with extremely large markdown input could block a goroutine for extended time
performance_issues.recommendation: Add context timeout or input size limit for markdown rendering

optimization_recommendations.description: Add request body size limit and rendering timeout
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Prevents resource exhaustion from oversized inputs
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use context.WithTimeout and limit request body size via middleware

resource_load.note: CPU-bound markdown parsing with pipe-based streaming. No DB or external calls.

performance_issues.description: No timeout or size limit on raw body reading and rendering
performance_issues.impact: Unbounded request body could exhaust memory; rendering has no timeout
performance_issues.recommendation: Add io.LimitReader on request body and context timeout

optimization_recommendations.description: Limit request body size and add rendering timeout
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Prevents memory exhaustion and CPU starvation
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Wrap ctx.Req.Body with io.LimitReader; use context.WithTimeout

resource_load.note: Returns pre-loaded in-memory slice. Zero cost per request.
Single filesystem read per request. Files are small (< 10KB typically).

performance_issues.description: Gitignore template files are read from disk on every request with no in-memory caching
performance_issues.impact: Minimal - files are small and OS-level page cache likely handles this
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider adding response-level caching headers (ETag/Last-Modified) for static content

optimization_recommendations.description: Add HTTP caching headers since gitignore templates rarely change
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 or ETag header

resource_load.note: Allocates response array and iterates pre-loaded license list. Lightweight.

optimization_recommendations.description: Response could be cached since license list is static after startup
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Eliminates per-request allocation of response array
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Cache the serialized JSON response or add HTTP caching headers

resource_load.note: Single filesystem read per request. License files can be larger (up to ~35KB).

performance_issues.description: License template files are read from disk on every request with no in-memory caching
performance_issues.impact: Minimal - OS page cache handles this, but license files are larger than gitignore files
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider adding response-level caching headers for static content

optimization_recommendations.description: Add HTTP caching headers since license templates rarely change
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduces redundant requests and filesystem reads from clients
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 or ETag header
